# F200 combined steel gameplay fixture

This disposable F200 2.0.77 fixture is a single Defaults-mode gameplay witness for the recognised Space Age plus BobTech Bob/Angel closure. It is deliberately narrower than the exact 69-row/28-private-carrier/875-setting F200 data admission: it consumes only the independently captured `recipe-prod-research_steel-1` row and one unchanged upstream steel route. It does not establish a catalogue, migration, multiplayer, ordinary-cost, menu-performance, or release result.

The complete independent published row comes from `tests/fixtures/bob-angel-f200-combined-published-473-expectations.json.gz` (`B80EDB79ABE75F3A19A3D7BD2B9CAB43343807D405C9E474E93219D542EDE633`): level one `recipe-prod-research_steel-1`, its exact two automation/logistic prerequisites, `8000*2^(L-1)` at 60 seconds, and exactly two `0.10` productivity effects on `angels-plate-steel` and `angels-plate-steel-2`. The NoMIR upstream context is `tests/fixtures/bob-angel-f200-combined-upstream-context.json.gz` (`C5B76C07B66A305099412E2BDBD63855234692C9D5DFF32B3351D0A100A75C7D`), derived from the preserved EAD7 control-without-MIR raw dump (`AD702CC98FA30A672C8A358305D0F562A5965E51F28CED8D0EFC8ABD26F5F487`). It fixes the `angels-steel-smelting-2` owner and its `angels-roll-steel` / `angels-plate-steel-2` unlocks, plus the unchanged advanced-crafting route of one roll to four steel plates.

The fixture marks only three named upstream technologies researched: `automation-science-pack`, `logistic-science-pack`, and `angels-steel-smelting-2`. It neither researches, queues, enables, levels, nor writes progress to a MIR technology, and it never assigns `recipe.enabled`. A real 100-Biolab farm must expose the native 50% drain, four module slots, quality-module support, normal entity quality, and its pressure-1000 surface condition; it consumes 4,000 automation and 4,000 logistic packs to finish the 8,000-unit infinite research once. The fixture uses `game.speed = 16` only to bound this disposable test world; the ordinary research count and time remain the native values.

After the real `on_research_finished` event advances the infinite row from level one to two, the fixture uses an unchanged module-free `assembling-machine-1` with the real `advanced-crafting` route to process exactly 100 `angels-roll-steel`. It drains the physical output while the machine runs and requires exactly 440 `steel-plate`, native route bonus `0.10`, and zero remaining native bonus progress. It saves `mir5-native-complete` once and each later cold process only reads the completed research, science, machine, and physical-output witnesses.

The read-only `mir5-bob-angel-f200-combined-gameplay/report` interface intentionally leaves a later EN/DE Library stage pending. That separate stage must use the existing public owned-Library method on this saved closure, retain fresh client screenshots/query/role/native-state observations, and perform no fixture-simulated input. This fixture makes no Base or Space Age Library result claim.
